label: GO step after a rewarded trial, late in the episode (trial >= ~60); strongest after rare-rewarded trials
explanation: Fires only at GO, only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=1 at D1), and only late in the episode: zero activations before trial 50, peaks in trials 80-89. The predicate GO & prev_reward==1 & ep_trial>=60 covers ~99% of activations and ~99.8% of activation mass on dev, but precision is only ~0.15: most late rewarded GO steps stay silent. Magnitude: the largest activations come after rare-rewarded trials (prev_common==0 holds ~67% of mass on ~34% of activations, precision 0.45) and mostly with a2 chosen (about 79% of mass with model_act==2) and mid/low value-head output (5.2-7.1); during long rewarded streaks it ramps slowly over consecutive trials (e.g. 0.10 -> 0.19 -> 0.26) and drops out after an unrewarded trial. Never fires at D1/D2, after unrewarded trials, or in the first half of the episode. Restricting the time range (trials 78-92) raises F1 only to ~0.44 at a cost in mass recall, so I recorded the simpler, high-coverage predicate. It uses only observed variables.
